title: Never-drop row cycle emits a logged self-assignment when the current lane is the only positive one
detail: At step==LANE_COUNT, next==cur. A never-drop class on the only positive-weight lane skips both zeroed lanes, then self-assigns: set_lane_class validates, bumps gen, and logs a redundant Cmd_Set_Lane (app/qos_panel.odin:155) with no visible change; the terminal toast covers only all-zero weights.
recommended_fix: Skip next==cur in the cycle (loop 1..<LANE_COUNT); when no different parkable lane exists, return without writing — or surface the reject toast — instead of logging the self-assignment.
